assets.prompt: Change only the western Eredane continent in the clean Caldris atlas candidate. Make its outline unmistakably broad east-west like the retained clean Eredane regional reference: about 1.4 times wider than tall, with a long nearly horizontal northern coast, broad southern coast, rounded western side, and southeast taper. Preserve and scale the northwest mountain arc, western mountain-and-forest mass, central lowlands and marsh, eastern mountain chain, and major rivers draining toward the southeast coast. Keep Solasca, the central sea, islands, border, corner flowers, clouds, palette, lighting, exact 1448x1086 dimensions, north-up orientation, and label-free presentation stable. Add no text, labels, letters, compass, icons, pins, routes, legends, symbols, markers, watermark, or third landmass.
assets.specificIntent: Caldris atlas with an Eredane western landmass visibly coherent with the retained Eredane regional map.
assets.referencePolicy: The prior clean atlas was the edit target and the retained clean Eredane map was the coastline and watershed reference. The prior atlas selection remains retained unmodified.
